_note: The city's own vocabulary, in words a reader knows. Every entry is a translation of a term that appears verbatim in the minutes, so a line using the right-hand side can be traced to the left. Nothing here is interpretation beyond the plain meaning of the code.

zoning.height and bulk limit: how tall and how big buildings may be
zoning.special use district: its own set of planning rules

streets.conditional acceptance of the roadway: the city takes over the new roadway
streets.full acceptance of the roadway: the city takes over the new roadway
streets.set-back lines: how far back buildings must sit
streets.through highway: a road with right of way over its side streets

process.Final Negative Declaration: found to have no significant environmental effect

money._rule: Under $1,000,000 print the exact figure with thousands separators: $808, $54,290, $750,000. At or above $1,000,000 round to one decimal and use M: $1.4M, $30.0M. Never mix the two forms and never write 'million' in words.

modern._note: Terms that appear verbatim in the minutes from roughly 1940 on. Same contract as the rest of this file: each is the plain meaning of a term the Board itself used, not an interpretation of what it did.
modern.encroachment permit: permission to build into the street
modern.inclusionary housing: below-market flats required in new buildings
modern.Mitigated Negative Declaration: a finding of no major environmental harm
modern.surplus property: land the city no longer needs
modern.Negative Declaration: a finding of no major environmental harm
modern.final negative declaration: a finding of no major environmental harm
